additional_info.subject: RE: ID0467223-DC/Si-D/CH-[MP / S0 170004107] DC Converter issue CRM:03056000770
additional_info.body:
Hello Mr. Müller,
Thank you for raising the issue. It show there is an error in Converter 5&6. But the charger is in operation. I can´t perform remote reboot during a charging session. After the charging session please perform a reboot.
It is also recommended the charger should update to latest firmware version. After that, if still the issue remain, we need to do manual troubleshooting.
Please let me know if you need further assistance.
Mit Freundlichen Grüßen/ Melhores Cumprimentos/ Best Regards
Harun Ar Rashid
Technical Support Specialist (eMobility)
Av. 25 de Abril 201, 2845-547, Corroios, Portugal.
